title: Usage Prediction That Works at Small N: Size Buckets, Resolvable Window Readings and a Same-Bucket Cross-Model Effort Ratio
target_platform: evaluating-agent-work usage ledger (claude, codex, agy) and the flight-board checkout/checkin hooks
hypothesis: If agents declare one of three size buckets (small, medium, large) at checkout instead of a free-text task class, and the percent-to-token calibration is fitted only on measurements where the window moved by at least 3 percentage points (or on tasks pooled to that size), then once 40 measured tasks exist with at least 8 per bucket: (a) the held-out token MAPE of the per-bucket median predictor is at most 30% and at least 20% below the static per-task ceilings; (b) the calibrated percent-to-token estimate lands within +/-50% on at least 8 of 10 held-out measurements; and (c) for at least one bucket run on two models, the measured effort ratio (wall time, cost, retries) differs from 1.0 by more than the run-to-run spread of the cheaper model.
falsification_criteria: With >= 40 measured tasks and >= 8 per bucket: held-out MAPE > 30% or not >= 20% better than the static ceilings; or fewer than 8 of 10 held-out window predictions within +/-50%; or no bucket has two models and a ratio outside the run-to-run spread (then the effort multiplier is noise at this scale); or bucket assignment by the agent disagrees with the measured size bucket on more than 30% of tasks (then declared buckets are not usable).
baseline_evidence: MISSION-035 at N=14 (FALSIFIED 2026-11-05, results-n14.md): per-free-text-class predictor MAPE 122.3% vs static 166.2% over 9 classes with 1-4 tasks each; calibration 56,349 tokens/pct with 5 of 8 leave-one-out predictions within +/-50% (all 3 misses are 1-2 pct tasks where the integer percent reading alone is 25-50% error); no task class ran on two models.

related_missions.MISSION-035: SPAWNED BY: falsified at N=14; this tests the repairs its data points to. Reuses its probe, hooks, delegation recorder and ledger.
related_missions.MISSION-016: CONSUMER: cheapest-viable routing needs token and effort predictions; this supplies them if (a)-(c) hold.
related_missions.MISSION-045: CONSUMER: selecting cross-vendor collaborators by measured complementarity needs per-model effort ratios (c).
